governance: §54-56/§91：Technical Golden 用于验证 Schema/Contract/Boundary/Pipeline/Canonical Gate/Serialization；Agent 只 READ/RUN/REPORT；CREATE/APPROVE/FREEZE 仅 Human Architect；CI 拒绝未授权修改

golden_list.name: Canonical Gate
golden_list.purpose: 验证 G-001~G-024 可执行且关键失败 FAIL_CLOSED

golden_list.name: Frozen Input
golden_list.purpose: 验证输入 Frozen Canonical Bazi Chart 不被下游修改

golden_list.name: Contract Validation
golden_list.purpose: 验证 contract.json 与 approved Contract 一致，Input/Output 白名单生效

golden_list.name: Import Isolation
golden_list.purpose: 验证 Static Import Boundary：L2A-E 无横向 import，SFTK 仅可读 L2A-E public

golden_list.name: Runtime Input Isolation
golden_list.purpose: 验证 Runtime Input Boundary：context 跨引擎读取被拒绝

golden_list.name: Forbidden Symbol Scan
golden_list.purpose: 验证 score/confidence/probability/percentage/vote/consensus/LLM/recalculate/sxtwl 等禁用符号被扫描

golden_list.name: Rule Trace
golden_list.purpose: 验证 Derived Fact → Rule 可追溯，无 Rule 的 Fact 拒绝

golden_list.name: Source Trace
golden_list.purpose: 验证 Rule → Source 可追溯，无 Source 的 Rule 拒绝

golden_list.name: Evidence Trace
golden_list.purpose: 验证 Judgment → Evidence 可追溯，无 Evidence 的 Judgment 拒绝

golden_list.name: Divergence Handling
golden_list.purpose: 验证 CLASSICAL_DIVERGENCE 仅在 M-9 条件下触发，且不得投票/平均消解

golden_list.name: Fail Closed
golden_list.purpose: 验证任何关键 Gate/Contract/Boundary/权限失败 → FAIL_CLOSED 且不向下游传播
